profile.summary: Youth Transportation Organization, also known as Yoots, is a nonprofit based in San Rafael, California. It works to remove transportation as a barrier for under-served youth. It helps schools and youth programs with field trips, charter buses, school bus logistics and BART trips in the San Francisco Bay Area.
